passives.name: 4th Match Flame
passives.description:
Every 4th Skill this unit uses gains Final Power +4 and inflicts 4 Burn On Hit
- If the said Skill is a Wrath Skill, deal +(Burn Potency on all targets / 2)% additional damage (max 20%)
- If the said Skill is an E.G.O Skill, apply the following effects at Coin Start of the first Coin:
· If the said Coin is a Plus Coin, heal 10 SP
· If the said Coin is a Minus Coin, lose 15 SP (this effect cannot reduce this unit's SP below -40)
passives.descriptionKo:
4번째로 사용하는 스킬의 최종 위력 +4, 적중 시마다 화상 4 부여
- 해당 스킬이 분노 속성이면, 추가로 피해량 +(모든 공격 대상의 화상 위력 / 2)% (최대 20%)
- 해당 스킬이 E.G.O 스킬이면, 첫번째 코인 시작 시
· 더하기 코인이면, 정신력 10 회복
· 빼기 코인이면, 정신력 15 감소 (이 효과로 정신력이 -40 미만이 되지 않음)

statuses.name: Before the King
statuses.desc: When this unit's attack with 1 Atk Weight hits, inflict 50% of the resulting Coin value On Hit as (Affinity/Attack Type of the Attack Skill used to hit) damage against 2 other attackable enemies with the least HP.

statuses.name: Before the King in Binds
statuses.desc: When this unit's attack with 1 Atk Weight hits, inflict 100% of the resulting Coin value On Hit as (Affinity/Attack Type of the Attack Skill used to hit) damage against 2 other attackable enemies with the least HP

statuses.name: Power Up
statuses.desc: Skills gain final Power by the effect’s Count for one turn.

statuses.name: Attack Power Up
statuses.desc: Attack skills gain final Power by the effect’s Count for one turn.

statuses.name: Bind
statuses.desc: Speed decreases by the effect’s Count for one turn.

statuses.name: Defense Level Up
statuses.desc: Defense Level increases based on the effect's Potency for one turn.

statuses.name: Gloom DMG Up
statuses.desc: Deal more damage with Gloom skills based on the effect’s Count for one turn. (Max 10)

statuses.name: Offense Level Up
statuses.desc: Offense level increases based on the effect's Potency for one turn.

statuses.name: Sinking
statuses.desc:
When hit by an attack, take fixed SP damage by the effect’s Potency.
(Non-SP Units take Gloom damage instead.)
Then, reduce its Count by 1.

statuses.name: Tremor
statuses.desc:
When attacked by skills that trigger Tremor Burst, raise the Stagger Threshold by the effect’s Potency.
At the end of the turn, reduce the Count by 1.

statuses.name: Tremor Burst
statuses.desc: Raise target's Stagger Threshold by Tremor Potency on target

statuses.name: Blubberbubble
statuses.desc:
- This effect counts as a 'Shield Management' effect.
- Turn End: Reduce Count by 1
- This unit does not lose Shield at Turn End as long as it has the Blubberbubble effect (unless depleted by damage or effect)
- If the Shield affected by Blubberbubble breaks due to taking damage, inflict 4 Sinking Potency/Count against the attacker. (How much of that '4' value is Potency or Count is randomly determined)
- This unit can stack their Shield value by using this effect. However, as long as Blubberbubble is in effect, the Shield value cannot exceed 60% of this unit's Max HP.

passives.description: Turn Start: Gain 2 Rhythm On Target Kill: This unit heals 5% HP and 5 SP (once per turn) - If target was killed by E.G.O - Harmony, double the amount this effect heals Turn End: If this unit lost SP this turn, heal (4 + sum of Burn and Bleed on all enemies / 10) SP (max 10; rounded down)
passives.descriptionKo:
턴 시작 시 리듬 2 얻음

대상 처치 시 자신의 체력을 최대 체력의 5%만큼 회복하고, 자신의 정신력 5 회복 (턴당 1회)
- E.G.O 스킬 - 하모니로 처치했으면 위 효과가 2배로 적용됨

이번 턴에 자신의 정신력이 감소했으면, 턴 종료 시 자신의 정신력을 (4 + 적 전체의 화상과 출혈 위력의 합 / 10)만큼 회복 (최대 10, 소수점 버림)
effects: Turn Start: Gain 2 Rhythm On Target Kill: This unit heals 5% HP and 5 SP (once per turn) - If target was killed by E.G.O - Harmony, double the amount this effect heals Turn End: If this unit lost SP this turn, heal (4 + sum of Burn and Bleed on all enemies / 10) SP (max 10; rounded down)

skills.name: Harmony
coinEffects:
Clash Power +1 for every 2 (Bleed + Burn) on the main target (max 10)
Deal more damage based on missing HP on self (max 20%)
Deal -50% damage against sub-targets
[On Target Kill] All allies gain 2 Rhythm next turn (once per Skill)
[Attack End] Heal 12 SP for (1 + highest Reson.) other allies with the least SP (max 4 units)
[Attack End] For 2 turns, lose 8 SP at Combat End
[On Hit] Inflict 2 Bleed
[On Hit] Inflict 2 Burn

[Heads Hit] At 10%+ HP, take 4 ~ 8 HP damage (once per Coin)
- Then, Reuse this Coin (4 times per Skill)
- This damage does not Stagger or reduce this unit's HP below 1
[On Hit] Inflict 1 Burn
[On Hit] Inflict 1 Bleed
[On Hit] A random ally gains 1 ~ 3 Rhythm next turn (once per Coin)
coinEffectsKo:
메인 타겟의 출혈과 화상의 합 2당, 합 위력 +1 (최대 10)
자신의 잃은 체력 비율만큼 피해량 증가 (최대 20%)
서브 타겟에게 가하는 피해량 -50%
[대상 처치시] 모든 아군이 다음 턴에 리듬 2 얻음 (스킬 당 1회)
[공격 종료시] 자신을 제외한 정신력이 가장 낮은 아군 (1 + 최대 공명 수)명의 정신력 12 회복 (최대 4명)
[공격 종료시] 2턴 동안 전투 종료 시 정신력 8 감소
[적중시] 출혈 2 부여
[적중시] 화상 2 부여

[앞면 적중시] 자신의 체력이 10% 이상이면, 4 ~ 8 만큼 체력 피해 입음 (코인당 1회)
- 이후 이 코인 재사용 (스킬당 최대 4회)
- 이 효과로 흐트러짐 상태가 되거나 체력이 1 미만으로 감소하지 않음
[적중시] 화상 1 부여
[적중시] 출혈 1 부여
[적중시] 무작위 아군 1명이 다음 턴에 리듬 1 ~ 3 얻음 (코인당 1회)

Turn End: Halve the Count. (Rounded down)

statuses.name: Power Down
statuses.desc: All skills lose final Power by the effect’s Count for one turn.

statuses.name: Power Up
statuses.desc: Skills gain final Power by the effect’s Count for one turn.

statuses.name: Bind
statuses.desc: Speed decreases by the effect’s Count for one turn.

statuses.name: Clash Power Up

statuses.name: Defense Level Down
statuses.desc: Defense Level decreases based on the effect's Potency for one turn.

statuses.name: Defense Power Up
statuses.desc: Defense skills gain final Power by the effect’s Count for one turn.

statuses.name: Butterfly
statuses.desc:
- Unique Sinking
- Base Value: 0, Max Value: 15
- The Potency and the Count of this effect are called "The Living" and "The Departed", respectively.
- When hit, the attacker heals (The Living/4) SP. (min 1; rounded down)
- When hit, and if this unit's SP is at less than 0, take (Sinking Potency/5) Gloom damage for every value of The Departed. (max Gloom damage 30; rounded down; deals half damage to targets that are Non-SP Units.)
- Turn End: Reset The Departed of this effect to 0; then, gain Sinking equal to The Living and convert The Living into The Departed.
- No external effects can raise the amount of Butterfly inflicted. "Inflict additional Sinking" effects inflict additional Sinking instead of additional Butterfly.
- This effect expires when both The Living and The Departed reach 0.

(Non-SP Units take Gloom damage instead.)

statuses.name: Butterfly
statuses.desc:
- Unique Sinking
- Base Value: 0, Max Value: 15
- The Potency and the Count of this effect are called "The Living" and "The Departed", respectively.
- When hit, the attacker heals (The Living/4) SP. (min 1; rounded down)
- When hit, and if this unit's SP is at less than 0, take (Sinking Potency/5) Gloom damage for every value of The Departed. (max Gloom damage 30; rounded down; deals half damage to targets that are Non-SP Units.)
- Turn End: Reset The Departed of this effect to 0; then, gain Sinking equal to The Living and convert The Living into The Departed.
- No external effects can raise the amount of Butterfly inflicted. "Inflict additional Sinking" effects inflict additional Sinking instead of additional Butterfly.
- This effect expires when both The Living and The Departed reach 0.

statuses.name: Discard
statuses.desc:
- Delete Skills that fit the condition and are selectable during the Chaining Phase from the Dashboard. (Defensive & E.G.O Skills do not count. Does not delete the Skill from the upcoming Skills list)
- Discarded Skills will not activate Skill effects or Coin effects other than effects from Discard, and will not give E.G.O resources.

statuses.name: Gloom Resist Down
statuses.desc:
Increase Gloom Resistance based on Stack.
(0.1 per Stack)

statuses.name: Reload
statuses.desc:
- Effect applied to The Living & The Departed(Unique Ammo)
- Consume (30 - (The Living + The Departed))/2 SP. (rounded down)
- Reset both The Living and The Departed values on self to 0, and gain the max value of their sum based on the probabilities listed in the Passive 'ISeeTheDyingButterfly.'
- On Reload, gain at least 1 of The Living and The Departed.

statuses.name: The Living & The Departed
statuses.desc:
- Unique Ammo
- The sum of Potency and Count maxes out at 20.
- Consumed for certain Skills.
- Whether The Living(Potency) or The Departed(Count) will be consumed for each shot is randomly determined
- Some attacks cancel if this unit runs out of ammo.

statuses.name: Unfocused Volley
statuses.desc:
- When this Skill flips Coins, each Coin flips against a random enemy among its targets
· The first Coin always targets the main target
· All 'On Hit' effects and all damage dealt by each Coin are inflicted only against the random target the Coin selected

statuses.name: Gloom Fragility
statuses.desc: Take more damage from Gloom skills based on the effect’s Count for one turn. (Max 10)

statuses.name: Sinking
statuses.desc:
When hit by an attack, take fixed SP damage by the effect’s Potency.
(Non-SP Units take Gloom damage instead.)
Then, reduce its Count by 1.

statuses.name: Tremor
statuses.desc:
When attacked by skills that trigger Tremor Burst, raise the Stagger Threshold by the effect’s Potency.
At the end of the turn, reduce the Count by 1.

statuses.name: Tremor Burst
statuses.desc: Raise target's Stagger Threshold by Tremor Potency on target

statuses.name: Unbreakable Coin
statuses.desc:
- This coin does not break upon Clash Lose.
- If an Attack Skill has this Coin, attack with this Coin after getting hit.
- Upon Clash Lose, fix the Coin Power of the unbroken Coin to 1

statuses.name: Bind
statuses.desc: Speed decreases by the effect’s Count for one turn.

statuses.name: Blunt DMG Up
statuses.desc: Deal more damage with Blunt skills based on the effect’s Count for one turn. (Max 10)

statuses.name: Gloom DMG Up
statuses.desc: Deal more damage with Gloom skills based on the effect’s Count for one turn. (Max 10)

statuses.name: Gloom Fragility
statuses.desc: Take more damage from Gloom skills based on the effect’s Count for one turn. (Max 10)

statuses.name: Sinking
statuses.desc:
When hit by an attack, take fixed SP damage by the effect’s Potency.
(Non-SP Units take Gloom damage instead.)
Then, reduce its Count by 1.

statuses.name: Tremor
statuses.desc:
When attacked by skills that trigger Tremor Burst, raise the Stagger Threshold by the effect’s Potency.
At the end of the turn, reduce the Count by 1.

statuses.name: Tremor Burst
statuses.desc: Raise target's Stagger Threshold by Tremor Potency on target

statuses.name: Unbreakable Coin
statuses.desc:
- This coin does not break upon Clash Lose.
- If an Attack Skill has this Coin, attack with this Coin after getting hit.
- Upon Clash Lose, fix the Coin Power of the unbroken Coin to 1

이 스킬은 적에게 적중하지 않고, 수비 스킬을 발동시키지 않으며, 외부 효과로 재사용이 불가능함

skills.name: Unbrilliant Glory - Incandescence
coinEffects:
[Unclashable]
External effects cannot trigger this Skill to be Reused
At 40 Man in Scabbard, becomes Clashable
[On Use] At 40 Man in Scabbard, until this Skill ends, this unit cannot be Staggered from taking damage, and gains Clash Power +20

[Before Attack] Consume all Man in Scabbard and gain the following effects(all of them rounded down):
- For every (Stack consumed / 20), recuperate 1 E.G.O resource (in the following order: Pride, then Wrath)
- For every (Stack consumed / 10), gain +1 Atk Weight (max 4)
- For every (Stack consumed / 10), gain Defense Level Up (once per turn)
- If 40 Stack was consumed, the 4th Coin deals +100% damage, and this unit gains 2 Protection (once per turn)

[Before Attack] Deal +5% damage for every 8 (Burn + Tremor) on the main target (max 25%)
[Attack End] Heal 5 SP for every target that was Staggered or killed due to this Skill's damage (max 25)
[Attack End] Gain 1 Man in Scabbard
[Turn End] If this Skill did not consume 40 Man in Scabbard, the leftmost Skill Slot on the Dashboard gains +4 Aggro next turn (once per turn)

Unbreakable Coin
Reuse this Coin ((Man in Scabbard Stack consumed / 10) - 1) times (3 times max)
[Coin Start] If this Coin isn't Cracked, and if it targets 3+ enemies, the final Coin to be used deals +20% damage (for Focused Encounters, each Part counts as 1 target)
[On Hit] Inflict 1 Burn
[On Hit] Inflict 1 Tremor
[On Hit without Cracking] If this is the final Coin, and if target has 15+ Tremor Potency, trigger Tremor Burst; then, reduce target's Tremor Count by 1
[On Hit without Cracking] If this Coin was used 4 times, deal Sloth damage equal to Tremor on target (max 10)
coinEffectsKo:
이 스킬은 외부 효과로 재사용이 불가능함
[합 불가능]
칼집 속 사람이 40이면, 합 가능으로 변경됨
[사용시] 칼집 속 사람이 40이면, 이 스킬 종료 시까지 피해로 인해 흐트러짐 상태가 되지 않고 합 위력 +20
[공격 시작 전] 칼집 속 사람을 전부 소모하고 아래 효과 적용 (모든 수치는 소수점 버림)
- (소모한 수치 / 20) 만큼 E.G.O 자원 1개씩 반환 (오만, 분노 순으로 반환)
- (소모한 수치 / 10) 만큼 가중치 증가(최대 4)
- (소모한 수치 / 10) 만큼 방어 레벨 증가 얻음 (턴당 1회)
- 40 소모했다면, 4번째로 사용할 코인의 피해량 +100%, 보호 2 얻음 (턴당 1회)
[공격 시작 전] 메인 타겟의 화상과 진동의 합 8 당 피해량 +5% (최대 25%)
[공격 종료시] 이 스킬로 흐트러졌거나 사망한 대상 1명당 정신력 5 회복 (최대 25)
[공격 종료시] 칼집 속 사람 1 얻음
[턴 종료시] 이 스킬로 칼집 속 사람을 40 소모하지 못했다면, 다음 턴에 조작 패널의 가장 왼쪽 스킬의 스킬 슬롯 도발치 4 증가 (턴당 1회)

파괴 불가 코인
(소모한 칼집 속 사람 수치 / 10) - 1 만큼 코인 재사용 (최대 3회)
[코인 시작시] 이 코인이 파괴되지 않았고, 공격 대상이 일정 3명 이상이면, 마지막에 사용할 코인의 피해량 +20% (집중 전투인 경우, 부위를 대상 1명으로 취급)
[적중시] 화상 1 부여
[적중시] 진동 1 부여
[파괴되지 않고 적중시] 마지막에 사용하는 코인이고, 대상의 진동 위력이 15 이상이면, 진동 폭발. 대상의 진동 횟수 1 감소
[파괴되지 않고 적중시] 이 코인 4회 사용했다면, 대상의 진동만큼 나태 피해를 줌 (최대 10)

statuses.name: Bloodfeast
statuses.desc:
- Max Value: 999
- Stores all Bleed damage dealt in this zone
- Resets when moving to a different zone
- This value is shared by all characters
- If there is a higher Kindred among the allies who also consumes Bloodfeast, this unit cannot consume Bloodfeast until that ally consumes it first.

statuses.name: Bloodfeast Consumed
statuses.desc:
- Max Value: 999
- Displays the total amount of Bloodfeast consumed in this Encounter

statuses.name: Bloodfeast Consumed (shared)
statuses.desc: Total Bloodfeast consumed in this Encounter

statuses.name: Polydipsic Rose
statuses.desc:
- Max Value: 5
- Turn End: at 10+ Bleed Potency, take Lust damage equal to 1% of this unit's max HP. (max 30)
- Turn End: reduced by 1

statuses.name: Bleed
statuses.desc:
When tossing an attack Coin, take fixed damage by the effect’s Potency.
Then, reduce its Count by 1.

statuses.name: Unbreakable Coin
statuses.desc:
- This coin does not break upon Clash Lose.
- If an Attack Skill has this Coin, attack with this Coin after getting hit.
- Upon Clash Lose, fix the Coin Power of the unbroken Coin to 1

statuses.name: Drink to the Fallen
statuses.desc:
- Max Stack: 4
- Turn Start: Gain 1 Poise for every Stack
· Blade Lineage Mentor Meursault gains 2 Poise for every Stack instead
- Base Skills deal +(Poise on self x 1.5)% damage on Critical Hit (max 15%)
- Base Skills that gain Poise and Poise Count gain Clash Power +1
- Turn End: Lose 1 Stack

statuses.name: Growing
statuses.desc: At the end of the turn, add +1 Count, and gain Max HP proportional to the Count. (Max 3)

statuses.name: Growing Resentment
statuses.desc:
- Max Stack: 999
- "To Claim Their Bones" gains (Stack / 100) Final Power (max 6; rounded down)
- On Hit using the final Coins of either "Yield My Flesh" or "To Claim Their Bones", deal +(Stack / 10)% damage; then, this effect expires

statuses.name: Resentful Scabbard
statuses.desc:
- When an ally, including this unit, takes HP damage, gain Growing Resentment equal to damage taken
- In Memoriam Passive now ignores conditionals and activates at max potential
- When activating Pride Reson., apply Swordplay of the Homeland - The True Essence on all Blade Lineage allies other than this unit

- On Using "Yield My Flesh", until Skill End:
· This unit's HP does not drop below 10 (once per turn)
· Lose (Poise on self / 2) Clash Power (rounded down)
- On Using "To Claim Their Bones", gain 4 Poise

※ Sword of the Homeland - The True Essence effects:
- Base Attack Skills gain Final Power +(# of Blade Lineage allies on the field / 3) (max 2, rounded down)
- If this unit is a Blade Lineage Salsu, Base Skills gain Final Power +1 and deal +(120 / # of Coins)% damage
- Turn End: Gain 1 Haste next turn and this effect expires

statuses.name: Resentment
statuses.desc:

statuses.desc:
Base Stack: 0
Max Stack: 3
- All Coins on this unit's leftmost Base Attack Skill on the Dashboard become Unbreakable Coins
- Turn Start: gain 2 Offense Level Up and 2 Defense Level Down for every Stack
- Turn Start: at 3+ Stack, gain 1 Tarnished Blood (once per Encounter)
- Turn End: gain 1 Stack
※ Cannot raise the effect's Stack by any other means than the ones above
- Expires upon death or Retreat

- When this unit takes damage that brings their HP down to 0: instead of letting this unit's HP drop below 1, or becoming Staggered or Defeated, use the 'Tears of the Tarnished Blood - The End' Skill at the very end of that turn. Remove the Flower-burying Wedge when the Skill ends.
When this unit takes damage that brings their HP down to 1 at Turn End, use 'Tears of the Tarnished Blood - The End' Skill based on this unit's Speed next turn

statuses.name: Power Down
statuses.desc: All skills lose final Power by the effect’s Count for one turn.

statuses.name: Tarnished Blood
statuses.desc:
Max Stack: 5
- Turn End: take 20% HP damage per Stack (cannot be Staggered by this effect)
- Gain 1 Stack at Turn End
- Expires upon death or Retreat

statuses.name: Attack Power Down
statuses.desc: Attack skills lose final Power by the effect’s Count for one turn.

statuses.name: Fragile
statuses.desc: Take more damage from skills based on the effect’s Count for one turn. (Max 10)

statuses.name: Gluttony DMG Up
statuses.desc: Deal more damage with Gluttony skills based on the effect’s Count for one turn. (Max 10)

statuses.name: Haste
statuses.desc: Speed increases by the effect’s Count for one turn.

statuses.name: Pierce DMG Up
statuses.desc: Deal more damage with Pierce skills based on the effect’s Count for one turn. (Max 10)

statuses.name: Rupture
statuses.desc:
When hit by an attack, take fixed damage by the effect’s Potency.
Then, reduce its Count by 1.

statuses.name: Unbreakable Coin
statuses.desc:
- This coin does not break upon Clash Lose.
- If an Attack Skill has this Coin, attack with this Coin after getting hit.
- Upon Clash Lose, fix the Coin Power of the unbroken Coin to 1

statuses.name: Black Wings
statuses.desc:
- Max Stack: 12
- Turn Start: Gain (Stack / 4) Charge Count (rounded down)
- Turn Start: Gain 1 Offense Level Up for every 4 Stacks
- This unit's Skills that gain or consume Charge or Poise deal +(Stack)% damage

statuses.name: Crit DMG Up
statuses.desc: For this turn: Deal +10% damage on Critical Hit for every Stack

statuses.name: Power Up
statuses.desc: Skills gain final Power by the effect’s Count for one turn.

statuses.name: Attack Power Up
statuses.desc: Attack skills gain final Power by the effect’s Count for one turn.

statuses.name: Charge
statuses.desc: Resource used by certain skills for additional effects. Its Count can go up to 20. Count lowers by 1 at the end of each turn.

statuses.name: Damage Up
statuses.desc: Deal more damage with skills based on the effect’s Count for one turn. (Max 10)

statuses.name: Offense Level Up
statuses.desc: Offense level increases based on the effect's Potency for one turn.

statuses.name: Poise
statuses.desc:
On hit, gain a Potency-based chance to deal critical damage, reducing the Count by 1 if successful.
At the end of the turn, reduce the Count by 1.

statuses.name: Sinking
statuses.desc:
When hit by an attack, take fixed SP damage by the effect’s Potency.
(Non-SP Units take Gloom damage instead.)
Then, reduce its Count by 1.

statuses.name: Unbreakable Coin
statuses.desc:
- This coin does not break upon Clash Lose.
- If an Attack Skill has this Coin, attack with this Coin after getting hit.
- Upon Clash Lose, fix the Coin Power of the unbroken Coin to 1
